summary: Gain Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose interim clinical and biomarker data from the nine-month extension (Part 2) of its Phase 1b study of GT-02287 in Parkinson's disease patients with or without a GBA1 mutation. The data were presented at the 3rd International GBA1 Meeting 2026. Results showed reductions in glucosylsphingosine (GluSph) levels and stable MDS-UPDRS scores. No corporate transaction, capital event, or special situation is involved; this is a routine operational update on clinical trial progress.
